description: Apply a mode supplied by a maintenance request to a filesystem path.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary file-permission administration, not an evolutionary algorithm. The mode is operational metadata for a requested path; there is no candidate population or reproduction. os.chmod changes permissions on a caller-selected path without an allowlist. Policy basis: This filesystem capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
